svg.aria-label: 3D modelling: a soap box drafted layer by layer, exploded, turned and closed, loaded with soap scraps; in section a spring tray presses the soap onto four rollers, the box rolls over a surface and foam squeezes out; finally it hangs in a wall basket and water drains through the 12 slots in its base.
